label: List
when: short points that share one form, with a bullet, check mark or number (what is included, benefits, steps)
rules: One list-child-item per entry inside spectra/list. Each holds a self-closing list-child-icon, then a spectra/container {"variationSelected":true} with one spectra/content whose "text" is the entry. "index" on the item and "itemIndex" on its icon are the entry's position: 1, 2, 3. Unordered by default: "icon" on the list is the bullet (default "circle"; "check", "star", "arrow-right"). Steps: "listType":"ordered"; the icon shows the number from "index"; "listStyle" may be "lower-alpha" or "upper-roman". Color: "textColor" on the list. Never use core/list or list-item; never nest lists.
example:
<!-- wp:spectra/list {"icon":"check"} -->
<!-- wp:spectra/list-child-item {"index":1} -->
<!-- wp:spectra/list-child-icon {"itemIndex":1} /-->
